compact_schema.storage: historical compact base arrays plus readable Gaming supplement records
compact_schema.d: domain derived from URL at load time
compact_schema.id: stable sequential/name id derived at load time
compact_schema.l: sparse explicit login claims stored in the historical compact payload; unknown for supplements unless explicitly enriched
compact_schema.x: direct execution connector only when the connector can operate the listed service itself; hosted GitHub projects are not treated as executable merely because GitHub can read the repository
compact_schema.src: source spreadsheet and original row preserved on every routable record

routing_policy.tool_selection: Web Surfers entries may be auto-selected as candidate tools because the paid directory identifies the tool and URL.
routing_policy.execution: Automatic execution is allowed only when an approved runtime adapter/connector/API/MCP/CLI path can operate that listed service in the current runtime. A hosting/source-code connector is not an execution adapter for the hosted project.
routing_policy.lucas_mapping: Never infer Lucas Part numbers from Web Surfers membership alone. Lucas Part identity remains independently proven through the canonical data/tool-intelligence confidence registries.
routing_policy.unknown_interfaces: Unknown API/MCP/CLI fields are not executable.
routing_policy.side_effects: Writes, purchases, publishing, messages, destructive actions, and other consequential operations remain subject to runtime/user approval policy.

storage.note: The original three-sheet compact payload is preserved for stability. Runtime loaders filter its two unnamed URL-only Design rows, then append the authenticated Gaming supplement for 1,800 valid routable records.
